notes: One pass for compat-pair enumeration + posterior-covariance accumulation per individual. OpenMP across the outer sample loop with per-thread (H, H) accumulators reduced at end. The F2 LD-aware-pruning fix (haplotype_gwas._compute_ld_aware_score, commit f601f20) is upstream of this kernel and inherited via the already-pruned labels/freq arguments. Random planted haplotype fixture: G[i] = hap[a_i] + hap[b_i] with (a, b) drawn from the Dirichlet-distributed frequency vector.
consumer_summary: Shared kernel for PCHT (Phase 46 novel #1). The same posterior-covariance output drives all five novel methods (PCHT, HHCT, HSKAT, HapGxE, BayesHap) that consume Cov(D_i | g_i) downstream. The Python compat-list path (_reconstruct_compat) remains the spec for callers that need raw pair lists; the native shortcut bypasses both _reconstruct_compat and the per-sample Python accumulation.
